details.method: Publish CLI transport success only after prompt handoff, actual process close, required transcript flush and durable terminal reporting have completed; retain unknown if any observer fails.
details.when: An external worker terminal receipt is consumed by independent review or downstream scheduling and its transcript is required evidence.
details.counterexample: A process close callback alone does not settle asynchronous stream finalization; optional telemetry that is not required evidence does not by itself establish this gate.
details.trial_plan: Run real worker registration success and late transcript final failure fixtures; require true only for complete observation, false/reconcile_required for late failure.
